name: Ferienwohnung Wechselberger
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated in the Haflinger village of Ebbs, the Wechselberger family welcomes guests with genuine Tyrolean warmth in a bright, well-kept apartment facing the Zahmer Kaiser.

The Fohlenhof stud farm, trailheads into the Kaiser valley, and cycling paths are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Wechselberger in Ebbs provides family comfort at the foot of the Kaiser mountains in Kufsteinerland.
